about_item: BUILT FOR APPLE INTELLIGENCE — Apple Intelligence is the personal intelligence system that helps you write, express yourself and get things done effortlessly. With groundbreaking privacy protections, it gives you peace of mind that no one else can access your data — not even Apple.
TAKE TOTAL CAMERA CONTROL — Camera Control gives you an easier way to quickly access camera tools, like zoom or depth of field, so you can take the perfect shot in record time.

GET FURTHER AND CLOSER — The improved Ultra Wide camera with autofocus lets you take incredibly detailed macro photos and videos. Use the 48MP Fusion camera for stunning high-resolution images, and zoom in with the 2x optical-quality Telephoto.

PHOTOGRAPHIC STYLES — The latest-generation Photographic Styles give you greater creative flexibility, so you can make every photo even more you. And you can reverse any of those styles anytime you want.

SUPER-SMART A18 CHIP — A18 jumps two generations ahead of the A16 Bionic chip in iPhone 15. It enables Apple Intelligence, powers advanced photo and video features, and supports console-level gaming, with exceptional power efficiency.

summary.text: Customers find the iPhone's appearance premium and appreciate its faster performance with apps opening quickly. The display quality receives mixed feedback, with some praising the bright screen while others note outdated 60 Hz display technology. The battery life and camera quality also get mixed reviews, with some praising the big battery boost while others report it doesn't last more than 4 hours and the camera isn't as good as expected. Additionally, customers report issues with the phone not working properly after updates and experiencing heating problems.

authors_reviews.title: All rounder hero phone
authors_reviews.text: Something new cannot be written in a review for a device that has been reviewed thousands of times over the Internet. I'll put in the perspective of how a device for an its festive price of ~70k has exceeded expectations from all counts. Being an all rounder & being a hero phone seems easy these days (plethora of choices & awards showcases it). But being both, with supreme ability, in its budget segment is nothing short of an accomplishment. Summarising it in pros & cons for easy reference:Pros+ iOS is the main STAR! Fluidic, snappy and so easy to use that it feels natural+ There are better cameras but there aren't good point-shoot-auto correct cameras that handle all the work for you & produce spectacular photos/videos with 0 adjustments at this price+ Build Quality & Brand Recognition is off the charts+ Battery Backup is superb with easy 7-8 hours with no gaming & 3-4 hours of social media usage+ It'll last easy for 5-6 years with Apple's long term software support & resale value is very strongCons- A very good quality case (Spigen/Raeger) is highly recommended to protect investment. Repairs/Damages are costly- Display should & could have been better. Well something had to be kept for the 17- Gets really warm when on wireless charging- 20W wired charging. LoL!- Dedicated camera control is useless. It needs to be programmable

authors_reviews.title: Stable and Stylish Smartphone
authors_reviews.text: I've been using the iPhone 16 as my primary phone for daily use, and it's been a good experience overall.The battery comfortably lasts me a full day with normal use like calls, messaging, browsing, YouTube, and some camera use. Charging is decent, though I wish it was a bit faster.Performance is excellent. Apps open quickly, switching between apps is smooth, and I haven't noticed any lag during regular use. The phone also doesn't get noticeably warm unless I'm doing something heavy.The camera is reliable. Photos come out sharp with good colors, and video quality is really good. Night photos are decent too, although they're not perfect in every situation.The phone looks premium and feels comfortable to hold. The display is bright, touch response is smooth, and network connectivity has been stable with both 5G and Wi-Fi.If you're already using an older iPhone (12 or earlier), this feels like a worthwhile upgrade. If you have a recent model like the 15, the differences aren't huge. Overall, it's a dependable phone that does everyday tasks really well without any major complaints.
